working_tree: Uncommitted experimental implementation; hashes below identify the tested surfaces
implemented: Versioned receipt-key-signed private requests bind origin, pool/domain, directory, operator, random ID, method/arguments and canonical-time window
Opt-in same-node or standalone private purchase service requires explicit channel/request, ceiling and lifetime limits; no public payment routes are added
Opening an empty channel and issuing a dual-signed invoice atomically persist the encrypted request/result mapping with the allocation
Concurrent exact retries recover the original channel, claimant, invoice and response; changed terms under the same receipt-key/request-ID pair refuse
Quote and receipt methods enforce channel receipt-key ownership; canonical note confirmation alone credits prepaid bytes
Receipt retries deduplicate canonical credits across the credit/reply crash boundary; a speculative receipt cannot grant capacity
Bounded encrypted payer request outbox persists exact signed envelopes before caller-controlled transmission and survives restart
PrivateControl requires HTTPS, an independently accepted target, exactly one accepted CA and one to four accepted TLS SPKI pins; chain and hostname verification remain required
No proxies, redirects, system-root fallback or plaintext HTTP; request/reply signatures and bounded fixed-length or streamed response reads
Private RPC refusals expose a constant response without logging invoices, request IDs, note locations or internal errors
Authorization windows are checked against canonical publication and new quote/channel offer time; reply bounds support full native-sized tariffs

tests.scope: The combined gate preceded client-only SPKI hardening; node/core/VPN source surfaces are unchanged and the final client suite was rerun after hardening.

canonical_rpc_flow.native_purchase_submission: Explicit local fixture transaction; not an automatic payer broadcast API

qualification_limits: Canonical loopback HTTP RPC and real TLS client transport are separately qualified; no combined funded private routed/kernel or public-chain claim
Payer native broadcast/nonce recovery, native withdrawal and consolidation, operator income handoff and multi-operator wallet views remain unfinished
Released shielded_required still refuses before loading keys/journals; the reusable private control client is not a private tunnel runner
Local allocation caps bound storage but do not provide Sybil resistance; unrestricted public onboarding needs abuse controls
Private service-equivocation claims, zero-price grants, sponsored/mixed-spend adversarial paths and key custody/backup tooling remain unqualified
Production proving-key ceremony and independent cryptographic review remain required; local test setup is not suitable for real funds
No new formal theorem is claimed for RPC/network code. Existing pool AML, circuit and bounded accounting proof sources are unchanged
Deposits, withdrawals, relayer identity, timing and network metadata remain observable; payment does not prove physical delivery

prior_failed_gate.cause: The new service-restart fixture omitted audited node resume after embedded service shutdown suspended shared admission.
prior_failed_gate.fix: Explicitly resume canonical node admission after each intentional service stop. Production shutdown semantics are unchanged.

next_gate: Native private submission/recovery and wallet withdrawal/earnings integration, then a funded private route with kernel, restart, no-bypass and ExEx qualification
